exam.exam_name: Telangana Police Sub-Inspector & Police Constable Direct Recruitment (TGLPRB / TSLPRB)
exam.conducting_body: Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TGLPRB / TSLPRB)
aliases: Telangana Level Police Recruitment Board SCT Examination

source_evidence.captured_wording: The applicant has to paste a recent passport size photograph on a white paper and sign below the photograph in a box of 3.5 cm width x 1.5 cm height, scan the composite image (width 3.5 cm x height 6.0 cm) and upload file size not exceeding 50 KB.
source_evidence.document_title: Notification for Direct Recruitment of SCT Sub-Inspectors and Constables in Police Department
source_evidence.section_name: Annexure - Instructions for Online Application Form

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.
dimensions.permitted_pixel_range: Width 3.5 cm, photo height 4.5 cm, signature space 1.5 cm (total height 6.0 cm); max file size 50 KB (or individual photo 10-50 KB and signature 5-30 KB)

spectacles.source_wording: Permitted if eyes are clearly visible; dark glasses prohibited

requirements.requirement_name: Candidate Photograph with Signature (Composite Box or Separate)
requirements.content_instructions: JPG, JPEG; Width 3.5 cm, photo height 4.5 cm, signature space 1.5 cm (total height 6.0 cm); max file size 50 KB (or individual photo 10-50 KB and signature 5-30 KB); 3.5 cm x 6.0 cm total; Plain white/light background for photo; white paper for signature; Sign within the designated 1.5 cm box below the photo using black or blue pen; TSLPRB single composite template ensures photo and signature are uploaded simultaneously without mispairing

dimensions.fallback_reason: The body publishes a preferred pixel size without mandating it, so the size is honoured while the mode stays unspecified.

requirements.content_instructions: PDF; 100 KB to 500 KB PDF file containing study certificates; A4 original document; Determines candidate local zone/district under the Presidential Order 2018; consecutive 4 years maximum study establishes local district

image_requirements.file_size.evidence_reference: Notification for Direct Recruitment of SCT Sub-Inspectors and Constables in Police Department - Annexure - Instructions for Online Application Form (https://www.tglprb.in/notifications/sct_si_constable_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.file_size.reasoning: Byte ceiling converted from the published figure using 1 KB = 1000 bytes. No body in the researched set defines the unit, and the decimal reading is the smaller of the two, so a file satisfying it also satisfies a 1024-byte reading.

image_requirements.dimensions.evidence_reference: Notification for Direct Recruitment of SCT Sub-Inspectors and Constables in Police Department - Annexure - Instructions for Online Application Form (https://www.tglprb.in/notifications/sct_si_constable_2024.pdf)
image_requirements.dimensions.reasoning: Pixel dimensions transcribed from the cited source.

image_requirements.formats.preferred_for.reasoning: The body lists permitted formats without naming a preference. JPEG is selected from the permitted list; JPG and JPEG name the same format, so this chooses a spelling rather than a format.

image_requirements.composition.crop_prof.reasoning: One composition is used for every examination: the tightest crop that keeps hair, ears and the chin/beard boundary intact. No researched body publishes a coverage maximum this would breach, and all published minima are cleared by it.
